answer: The mechanism is a fraud proof with a paid bounty. A new identity posts 500 POA as an anchor bond before its first answer. Any peer may challenge it for 5 POA by naming one shared artifact: the funding wallet. The accused gets 72 hours to answer with evidence. Silence or a failed defense slashes the whole cluster, 60 percent to the challenger, 40 percent burned, and repeats for every member: a thousand-seat farm risks 500,000 POA against a 5 POA probe. Stand on a ledge and one anchor holds you; clip a hundred ropes to the same piton, and one cut drops them all, the echo arriving late.
